declarations.description:
Marks the parts of its text that match a query, the way a search result list, a command palette or a filtered
table shows why a row matched. The text is the element's own text content; each match is drawn as a `<mark>`.

Matching ignores letter case unless `match-case` is set, and can also ignore accents (`ignore-accents`), match
whole words only (`whole-word`) or every word of the query on its own (`words`). Several queries can be given at
once by assigning an array to the `query` property. `active-index` singles out one match, for a find bar that
steps through them; the match count is the `matchCount` property, the `match-change` event and the custom state
`c2-highlight:state(matched)`.

The same matcher is exported as `findMatches(text, query, options)` for code that filters or ranks the items
it highlights.
declarations.name: Highlight

cssParts.name: mark

cssParts.description: The match at `active-index`, which also carries the `mark` part.

slots.description: The text to search. Only its text content is used: elements inside it are read as plain text.

members.name: query
members.description:
Text to highlight. Assign an array to the property to highlight several queries at once. White space at either
end is kept, so `" app"` only matches after a space; an empty query highlights nothing.

members.name: matchCase
members.description: Compares letter case exactly. Off by default, so `app` matches `Apple`.

members.name: ignoreAccents
members.description: Ignores accents and other diacritics, so `cafe` matches `café` and the other way round.

members.name: wholeWord
members.description: Only highlights matches that are whole words, so `app` no longer matches inside `Apple`.

members.name: words
members.description: Splits the query on white space and highlights every word on its own, the way a search box usually matches.

members.name: activeIndex
members.description:
Zero-based index of the match drawn as the current one (part `active`), for a find bar stepping through the
matches; `-1` marks none. When it changes, the match is scrolled into view.

members.name: text
members.description: Text read from the light DOM; `null` until the element is connected, so a server render keeps the slot.

members.name: serverRendered
members.description: A declarative shadow root from a server render: the first client render has to match its slot before marking.

members.name: matchCount
members.description: Number of matches in the current text.

events.name: match-change
events.description: Fired when the number of matches changes; `detail` is the new `matchCount`. Does not bubble.

declarations.description:
A find bar for a region of the page: a query field, the "3 of 12" count, previous and next, match case and whole
word toggles, an optional replace row and Escape to close. It drives the `c2-highlight` elements of its target (the
element named by `for`, or the `target` property): it sets their `query`, `match-case` and `whole-word`, counts
their matches in document order and moves `active-index` through them, so the current match scrolls into view.

The target is one `c2-highlight` or any element holding several, such as a list of search results or a log; a
highlight added later is picked up on the next keystroke. The bar never edits text: "Replace" and "Replace all"
fire `replace` with what to replace, and the application changes its own text, which the highlights then re-read.
Escape and the close button fire `close` and clear the highlights; the application hides the bar.

Keyboard: Enter and Shift+Enter step to the next and previous match, Alt+C and Alt+W toggle match case and whole
word, Escape closes. In the replace field, Enter replaces the current match and Ctrl+Enter (⌘+Enter) every match.
declarations.name: FindBar

members.name: for
members.description: Id of the element to search, looked up in the bar's own document or shadow root: one `c2-highlight` or an element holding several.

members.name: target
members.description: The element to search, which wins over `for`.

members.name: value
members.description: The query, as typed in the field.

members.name: matchCase
members.description: Compares letter case exactly; the "Aa" toggle sets it.

members.name: wholeWord
members.description: Only matches whole words; the "ab" toggle sets it.

members.name: replace
members.description: Shows the replace row. The replacing itself is the application's, on the `replace` event.

members.name: replacement
members.description: Text of the replace field.

members.name: label
members.description: Accessible name of the query field. Empty: "Find" in the page language.

members.name: counted
members.description: False until the first count, so a server render and the first client render show no "No results".

members.name: matchCount
members.description: Number of matches across the target.

members.name: activeIndex
members.description: Zero-based index of the current match across the target, `-1` for none.

members.name: focus
members.description: Focuses the query field and selects its text, the way pressing Ctrl+F again does in a browser; re-applies the query.

members.name: next
members.description: Moves to the next match, wrapping after the last.

members.name: previous
members.description: Moves to the previous match, wrapping before the first.

members.name: clear
members.description: Clears the highlights of the target, keeping the query in the field. The next keystroke or `focus()` re-applies it.

members.name: listen
members.description:
`match-change` does not bubble, but a capturing listener on the target hears every highlight inside it (an edit,
a replace). A mutation observer catches a highlight added to or removed from the target, such as a filtered list.

members.name: onMatchChange
members.description: Only a highlight's count: the bar's own `match-change` reaches this listener too when the bar sits inside its target.

members.name: sync
members.description: Pushes the query and options to every highlight of the target, then counts. `restart` moves to the first match.

members.name: locate
members.description: The highlight holding the global match `index`, and the match's index inside it.

events.name: match-change
events.description: Fired when the number of matches or the current match changes. Does not bubble.

events.name: close
events.description: Fired by Escape and the close button. Cancelable: cancelling keeps the highlights. Does not bubble.

events.name: replace
events.description: Fired by "Replace" and "Replace all" (and Enter in the replace field) when there is a match. Does not bubble.
Re-dispatched from the query field as the user types.
